name: FreeCalling
description: Private peer-to-peer audio and video calls using a unique Call ID. No account, no tracking, no ads.
author: Team MakeWorldHappy

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://*.firebaseio.com https://*.firebasedatabase.app https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://*.workers.dev; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
